title: Little Penguin, Time to Tidy!
caption: A little story about putting toys away.
alt: A navy blue paper-collage penguin wearing a coral scarf waves beside a mustard yellow box filled with colorful toys.

title: Time to play
cue: Can you say vroom, vroom? Tap to look around.
alt: Little Penguin plays with two colorful blocks, a green toy car, and a striped yellow ball. An empty mustard toy box stands nearby.

title: Playtime is done
lines: My toys are on the floor.
cue: Tap the toys. Time to tidy!
alt: Little Penguin looks at the scattered red and blue blocks, green car, and yellow ball, then points toward the empty open toy box.

title: One little block
cue: Tap to help put the red block away.
action: Put the red block in the box
alt: Little Penguin releases the red block directly above the open mustard toy box. The blue block, green car, and striped yellow ball remain on the floor.

title: One more block
cue: Tap to help put the blue block away.
action: Put the blue block in the box
alt: Little Penguin releases the blue block into the toy box beside the red block already inside. The car and ball remain outside.

title: Vroom, little car
cue: Tap to help park the little car.
action: Put the green car in the box
alt: Little Penguin lowers the green toy car into the open box with both blocks inside. Only the striped yellow ball remains on the floor.

title: One last toy
cue: Tap the ball. In it goes!
resultAlt: All four toys are inside the mustard box. The floor is clear and Little Penguin shows two empty flippers.
feedback: The ball is in. All toys away!
alt: Little Penguin releases the striped yellow ball above the toy box containing the red block, blue block, and green car. Nothing remains on the floor.

title: All toys away
cue: Look around with Little Penguin. Anything left?
action: Check that every toy is put away
feedback: All clear! You put every toy away.
alt: Little Penguin looks around the clear floor with empty flippers open. Both blocks, the car, and ball are visibly stored inside the open mustard box.

title: Hooray, Little Penguin!
cue: Tap a flipper for a high five!
action: Give Little Penguin a high five
feedback: High five! I can tidy up, too!
alt: Little Penguin raises a flipper for a high five beside the neatly filled toy box. The floor is clear.
